title: [Challenge] My Digital Closet Challenge Season4 #NarutoRun
content:
Hello, Creators!  
  
It’s finally back!  
CONNECT’s **mydigital closet** Challenge Season 4   
— this time with 3D artist **Minstin**! ✨

# The theme? **Naruto Run!** 🌀

You know the iconic pose — arms stretched straight back, sprinting at full speed!  
Now, take on the Naruto Run with our adorable CONNECT Kids Avatar!

![b113058597a94d0a93348b4e29d25f10](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/a254a0c1a8ab4da485de19bcd943079e/images/b113058597a94d0a93348b4e29d25f10CONNECT_thumbnail%20long.webp)

* * *

All challenge assets are available for **free download** on CONNECT.  
Check the challenge details below and join in!  


* * *

  
After uploading to SNS, leave a comment on this post with the URL to your content. We’ll check the comments and feature your work on our Instagram!**😊**

You can also **show off your challenge video or link**  
**in the CONNECT community!  
** Set the post topic to Challenge and share your work with others!**🚀✨**

  


* * *

# **📌Challenge Details**  


  * Title : **MyDigitalCloset_Naruto Run**  
  


  * Concept: Open Theme

    * **There are no concept restrictions. Outfits with various concepts are welcome!**

    * Feel free to showcase any 3D outfits you’d like to introduce.

    * Previously released outfits are also welcome.



  * Participation Period: Ongoing  
  


  * Participation Requirements

    * Use the motion file and avatars provided by CONNECT.

    * Collaboration is encouraged—multiple creators can work together to create a collaborative piece.

    * Upload your completed work to Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or Tiktok using the relevant hashtags.

      * #mydigitalcloset #lookbook #challenge #digitalfashion #connectofficial #clo3d #marvelousdesigner #challengebyCONNECT  
  




  * **Participation Process  
** 1\. Download Motion and Avatar: Download the motion file and the avatar provided by CONNECT.

    * Motion : [**_KV1.1_NarutoRun_**](https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/3b179edda10443b0852c780f580ce6ed)

    * Avatar : [**_KV1.1_River_24M_  
  
**](https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/da6bd21345d7445b87f13e5865841103)




2\. Creating Garment Animation: Apply the motion to each outfit project file and press the record button in animation mode to create the outfit animation.

  * **TIPS**

    * Running motion is highly dynamic and can be unstable, please refer to the tips below when creating your simulation.

      * **Increase Scene Time Warp (recommend 2~3)**

      * **Increase Simulation Quality**

    * The wind effect used in the challenge video is included in the motion download link, so feel free to use it with your garment simulation.




**  
**

3\. Rendering: Render the completed animation file.

  * We recommend an image size of 1080px * 1920px.

  * TIP : Use the CONNECT official [**_Scene_**](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/208988/collection/collections/2312DD1c848deff0094e4991a906bfc52dae0e) and [**_Prop_**](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/208988/collection/collections/2312DD5b079406e1b74752893f4f72b525ee8c) file _  
  
_




4\. Editing: Edit the rendered video using an editing program.

  * You can refer to[ **_this video_**](https://www.instagram.com/reel/C_zgG9Qv37o/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==) for the editing process.

  * Feel free to use other programs if you prefer.

  * Background Music : Free choice  
  





5\. Upload to SNS: Upload your finished work to Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or TikTok.

  * Include the following hashtags

    * #mydigitalcloset #lookbook #challenge #digitalfashion #connectofficial #clo3d #marvelousdesigner #challengebyCONNECT  
  





6\. Complete Participation

  * Once uploaded to SNS, leave a comment on **this post** with your email address and the URL to your content.

    * Example : Participation Complete / www.example.com

  * You can also **show off your challenge video or link in the CONNECT community!**

    * Set the post topic to Challenge and share your work with others!




* * *

Challenge Enquiry

1\. Direct message on [**_Instagram_  
**](https://www.instagram.com/letsconnect3d/)2\. Comments on **this page**  


* * *

![c1ed4816d0464a9da48e6fa312bfa791](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/a254a0c1a8ab4da485de19bcd943079e/images/c1ed4816d0464a9da48e6fa312bfa791Banner_Final.jpg)

** _It’s your turn to show off your Naruto speed! ⚡💛_**

  
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/a254a0c1a8ab4da485de19bcd943079e/images/d113602cbaef44799b2e0994351f81caCommunity%20%20thumbnail.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/a254a0c1a8ab4da485de19bcd943079e/images/6293682b487f4910a19e214cfb9c097aCommunity%20%20thumbnail.png)
content_description: Join the **mydigital closet** Challenge Season 4 and showcase your creativity by animating the iconic Naruto Run with our CONNECT Kids Avatar!

title: Marvelous Designer 2025.1 is here with 6 key features!
content:
![24e0f96ac3594e4c80f4383902aeefc3](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/f4db0954ebea41aab139ab52bc7ccc37/images/24e0f96ac3594e4c80f4383902aeefc3Social%20Media%20Release%202025.1.png)

**_Easier to use, with more new tools to master. Upgrade your workflow with 6 powerful new features._**

**Update Marvelous Designer to version 2025.1**

**Designed to speed up and improve your Marvelous Designer workflow, 2025.1 introduces new ways to create, customize, and control.  
**

🎥 [Watch the Overview Video](https://youtu.be/zL9RcGpJG7E)

📚 [Explore the Tutorials](https://www.youtube.com/@Marvelousdesigner)

* * *

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bya0lS4Q1zo?start=0

**Off-Avatar 3D Pen Drawing**

For Marvelous Designer users that are more comfortable working in the 3D environment, this feature allows them to create patterns easily. Users can create straight or curved connected lines on and around the avatar with the existing 3D pen tool, and flatten it into 2D pattern pieces. 

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y3NyuAf-kik?start=0

**Keep Topology after Autofitting**

This update makes it possible to maintain the topology during Auto Fitting, dramatically reducing working time for users. Auto fitting maintains original mesh topology, enabling seamless reuse of existing assets such as UVs, rigging, blend shapes, and vertex colors without manual rework across 3D workflows.  


YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LwjWgF3AAH4?start=0

**Pattern Drafter (Beta)**

Users can now generate patterns based on their selection of clothing type. They can easily adjust the values, save, and load them. In addition, they can seamlessly create patterns from any uploaded image.

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2CsJKrN_CdY?start=0

**Softbody for Custom Avatars**

With the new update, Marvelous Designer now supports softbody simulation for custom and non-skeletal avatars.

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sI3vbxPd60Y?start=0

**Denim Wet Wash**

This denim preset allows users to easily create denim wet wash effects. In the fabric property editor, users can choose the denim type and adjust the denim-specific parameters to control wash effects. This includes Rinse, Enzyme, Stone, Acid, Bleach, and Ozone wash effects.  


YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qVleKIhYAls?start=0

**AI Pose Generator (Beta)**

Users can create pose files for their avatars using text prompts or uploaded and generated images within Marvelous Designer via the new AI Pose Generator. You can create poses, add clothing with those poses, check the desired fit, and produce the desired result more easily.

* * *

**_The Future of Marvelous Designer is Here._**

From drafting a pattern to applying the final details, update 2025.1 offers new creative features and speeds up the process at the same time.  


➡️[ Download the update now](https://marvelousdesigner.com/product/download)

📽️ [Watch the feature tutorials](https://www.youtube.com/@Marvelousdesigner)
content_description: Discover the powerful new features in Marvelous Designer 2025.1 designed to enhance your workflow and creativity in fashion design.
